subject: Request: elevated comp package approval for Skyler Davies (Sr ML Eng)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Erica Morales <erica@brightpathtalent.com>, Skyler Davies <skyler.davies@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: elevated comp package approval for Skyler Davies (Sr ML Eng)

Team —

Quick request for an exception approval. We’ve progressed Skyler Davies (candidate from BrightPath) through final onsite and the hiring panel rated them at the top of the band for Senior ML Engineer. The hiring manager (Asha) and I are asking to make an exception to the comp band for two reasons:

- Market dynamics: Skyler has a counteroffer and base expectations ~18% above our published band.
- Unique fit: deep retrieval + production tuning experience that maps exactly to a roadmap priority (Realtime Indexing).

Proposed package (total cash + equity):
- Base: $220,000 (band midpoint is $185k)
- Sign-on: $35,000 (one-time)
- Equity: 0.25% refresh (4 year cliff, 1 year vest)
- Target OTE (first year realized): ~$300k

I’ve attached the offer proposal and a short comp model that shows projected budget impact and comparable hires. This would require an exception to the published band and an approval for a sign-on + equity refresh. Can you weigh in on whether we can greenlight at this level? If yes, we’ll route to People Ops for formal docs and to Legal for usual checks.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15 if helpful.

Ben
Ben Carter
Recruiting Lead, Engineering Hiring Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Erica Morales <erica@brightpathtalent.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: elevated comp package approval for Skyler Davies (Sr ML Eng)

Ben —

Thanks for the summary. A couple quick items I need before I can approve:

1) Compensation rationale one-pager: call out which specific skills justify the premium (e.g., RL search kernel, low-latency KV cache ops) and panel calibration notes.
2) Budget owner sign-off: who is absorbing the incremental $35k recurring increase in run-rate if base is higher (product or infra)?
3) Confirmation that we’ve exhausted internal band adjustments (i.e., manager confirmed no internal candidate to promote).

If you can get those over by EOD Wednesday I’ll prioritize review. Also flag if we need a special exec signoff; if so, I’ll loop in Vivek.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Erica Morales <erica@brightpathtalent.com>, Skyler Davies <skyler.davies@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2027 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: elevated comp package approval for Skyler Davies (Sr ML Eng)

Laura —

Appreciate the quick review. Attached is the one-pager and the comp model; answers inline below: 

1) Rationale highlights (from panel notes):
   - Led production rollout of a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline at scale (90M QPS/day) with custom attention optimizations; authored internal kernel patches used in infra.
   - Prior work includes open-source quantization tooling that reduced inference costs by ~22% on similar stacks.
   - Strong product partnership history; immediate impact on our Realtime Indexing roadmap.

2) Budget owner: Product Infra (team 6x) has agreed to absorb base delta out of FY28 headcount budget; they confirmed fund reallocation in writing (see comp_model_q4_2027.xlsx tab 'approvals').

3) Internal promotion: manager confirmed there is no immediate internal candidate; team constraints mean we would backfill at L4 if we lose this candidate.

Timing: candidate has a competing offer and requests decision by Friday 11/05. If we can approve the sign-on + equity refresh now, I’ll issue the verbal and follow with official offer.

Attachments: Skyler_Davies_offer_proposal.pdf (offer draft), comp_model_q4_2027.xlsx (budget impact + owner note).

Ben
Ben Carter
Recruiting Lead, Engineering Hiring Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Erica Morales <erica@brightpathtalent.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: elevated comp package approval for Skyler Davies (Sr ML Eng)

Ben / Laura —

Reviewed the materials and the panel calibration notes. I approve the exception with the following conditions: 

- Approve base at $220,000, sign-on $30,000 (reduced from $35k) paid over first payroll cycle, and equity refresh at 0.20%.
- Offer to include a 12-month clawback on sign-on if employee leaves voluntarily within 12 months.
- People Ops to verify final comp against FY28 quota and update headcount tracker; Product Infra to confirm reallocation in writing to Finance.

Ben: proceed to extend verbal with the approved tweaks, have the candidate sign the acknowledgement for the clawback, and route final docs via People Ops + Legal. Please confirm once the offer is accepted.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
